implementer.notes:
Input revision: main 506c9dd4a2dcf97da33e1308ad89acc46facbed6, the same as the origin/main tip at fetch.

SPEC/LINEAR DISAGREEMENT: the coordinator and the spec both said to fix both files on main. But worker/src/recovery/browserRecovery.test.ts (and browserRecovery.ts) exist only on codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003 (#564), whose merge-base with main is main's tip. The Linear issue wins and needs both files. Since that half cannot be done on main, I created child issue OVD-636 (parent OVD-633, Backlog) with the unverified analysis below, and I fixed the main-side half only.

Unverified browserRecovery analysis (recorded in OVD-636):
- The 'bounded recovery with observed Chromium DOM' tests run three real-Chromium attempts each on the default 5 s per-test timeout.
- browserRecovery.ts enforces a production 5 s attempt deadline and 1 s fill/select/inputValue timeouts. Cancellation returns false, which fits 'expected true, received false'.
- A fix probably needs an injectable deadline for tests, not a longer production deadline, so the bounded-action guarantee is kept.

Xometry root cause: the waiting lifecycle polls the sidecar with a real sleep(1_000), so the second launch lands at about 1008-1013 ms. The test released the first lifecycle at about 107 ms and used vi.waitFor's default 1000 ms window, which closes at about 1107 ms. That is an unintended margin of about 100 ms (measured by a scratch probe, both unloaded and during a full-repo run). Stalls over about 100 ms across the poll tick fail the test.

Fix: the mocks resolve deferreds at the first launch and at the start of the first persist. The second-launch count is asserted after Promise.all of both lifecycles. Every expect from the original test is still there, and two were added: the second launch happens after the first persist finished, and persist ran 2 times.
- No timeout raised: this test has no real browser.
- No vitest config change: there is no real-browser file on main to serialize.

Diff review aid: the old expects were 'camoufox x1' (now asserted after awaiting firstLaunched), 'persist x1' (after awaiting firstPersistStarted), 'camoufox x1' (kept), and 'camoufox x2' (now after the settled lifecycles instead of inside waitFor). All later expects are unchanged.

Other actions:
- Linear: one rolling comment 24b440c6-de18-4f27-aaf7-16d39e6c2dc8 on OVD-633, updated with the PR, head and evidence. OVD-633 moved Backlog -> In Progress and left there. PR link attached to OVD-633 only.
- node_modules symlinks to /home/user/Overdrafter were created and left in place; lockfiles are identical to main.
- Scratch harnesses and logs are under /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Overdrafter/b20cace5-8784-51f8-a7b4-1ed188995a77/scratchpad/ovd633/ (stallrun.sh, loadrun.sh, inject.sh, mutate.sh, red/, green/, mut/, checks/, scratch-tests/).
- All load processes I started (busy-loop hogs, a stopped background run) were terminated; I touched no other processes.
- An attempt to create a cgroup CPU throttle was denied by the permission classifier, and I did not pursue it further. The SIGSTOP/SIGCONT stall harness on my own process group was used instead.
- No merge was performed.
